name: Shop 01 (lamp)
description: Sells desk lamps, chairs and bookshelves. Negotiates the price with the buyer.

skills.name: Negotiate a purchase
skills.description: Sells: lamp. Ask for one of these, then send a price as a number. The shop answers with a counteroffer or a receipt.
examples: I want to buy a lamp
